title: Indole-based NNN donor Schiff base ligand and its complexes: Sonication-assisted synthesis, characterization, DNA binding, anti-cancer evaluation and in-vitro biological assay.
authors: Sanjurani, Thangjam; Paul, Sneha; Barman, Pranjit
one_liner_zh: 该文合成吲哚类Schiff碱金属配合物并评估其DNA结合、抗癌等生物活性，虽含DNA结合实验和分子对接，但对象为小分子配合物而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法以实验为主、对接简单，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: A novel indole based NNN donor Schiff base ligand and its Ni(II), Zn(II) and Cd(II) complexes have been synthesized using sonication-assisted method which is a highly efficient eco-friendly mechanism. The synthesized complexes have been characterized using elemental analysis, UV-Vis spectroscopy, mass spectrometry, FT-IR, and NMR and are optimized using DFT approach, which provided their theoretical framework. The stoichiometry between the ligand and the metal ions was also determined using Job's method. The thermogravimetric (TGA/DSC) analyses confirm the stability for all complexes at room temperature followed by thermal decomposition in different steps. DNA binding activities have been assessed by employing UV-visible and fluorescence spectra using the CT-DNA. The estimated intrinsic binding constant (K(b)) for NiL, ZnL, and CdL complexes was 6.00 x 10(5), 5.58 x 10(5), and 4.7 x 10(5), respectively. In accordance with the K(b) value, the quenching constant (K(sv)) values of NiL, ZnL, and CdL are 5.59 x 10(5) M(-1), 4.3 x 10(5) M(-1), and 4.08 x 10(5) M(-1) respectively. The anticancer properties have been assessed using MTT Assay. It has been found that the Ni(II) complex (NiL) is the most potent among the series with IC(50) of 169 microg/mL. An in-vitro antioxidant experiment using DPPH was used to evaluate the synthesizedcomplexes' ability to scavenge free radicals. The findings indicated that the complexes exhibited notable antioxidant properties. The antioxidant property ZnL has been found to be the highest with an IC(50) of 2.91 microg/mL and it follows the order is ZnL > NiL > CdL > L. Using the egg albumin denaturation technique, the anti-inflammatory property have been assessed, and the amount of protein denaturation inhibition has been computed. NiL has the highest % inhibition among the series studied. Comparatively, the metal complexes have been reported to exhibit higher biological activities than the prepared Schiff base ligand. The reason for the excellent biological properties observed in the metal complexes could be attributed to the incorporation of the electron-withdrawing CH(3)COO(-) during complexation. Molecular docking studies have been performed on the 2GYT protein and it has been found that the complexes have excellent binding affinity, with NiL having the lowest binding energy of -6.93 Kcal mol(-1). The values suggested that NiL is more effective against HePG2 cancer cells, which is also in accordance with the MTT Assay results.
abstract_zh: 采用超声辅助法合成了一种新型吲哚基NNN供体席夫碱配体及其Ni(II)、Zn(II)和Cd(II)配合物，该方法是一种高效环保的机制。通过元素分析、紫外-可见光谱、质谱、FT-IR和NMR对合成的配合物进行了表征，并利用DFT方法进行优化，提供了其理论框架。配体与金属离子之间的化学计量比也通过Job法确定。热重分析（TGA/DSC）证实所有配合物在室温下稳定，随后在不同步骤中发生热分解。通过使用CT-DNA的紫外-可见和荧光光谱评估了DNA结合活性。NiL、ZnL和CdL配合物的估算固有结合常数（K(b)）分别为6.00 x 10(5)、5.58 x 10(5)和4.7 x 10(5)。根据K(b)值，NiL、ZnL和CdL的猝灭常数（K(sv)）分别为5.59 x 10(5) M(-1)、4.3 x 10(5) M(-1)和4.08 x 10(5) M(-1)。抗癌性质通过MTT实验进行评估。结果发现，Ni(II)配合物（NiL）在该系列中活性最强，IC(50)为169微克/毫升。使用DPPH进行体外抗氧化实验，以评估合成配合物清除自由基的能力。结果表明，这些配合物表现出显著的抗氧化特性。其中ZnL的抗氧化性最高，IC(50)为2.91微克/毫升，顺序为ZnL > NiL > CdL > L。通过卵清蛋白变性技术评估了抗炎性质，并计算了蛋白质变性抑制量。在所研究的系列中，NiL具有最高的抑制百分比。相比之下，金属配合物比制备的席夫碱配体表现出更高的生物活性。金属配合物中观察到的优异生物活性可能归因于配位过程中引入的吸电子CH(3)COO(-)。对2GYT蛋白进行了分子对接研究，发现这些配合物具有优异的结合亲和力，其中NiL的结合能最低，为-6.93 Kcal mol(-1)。这些值表明NiL对HePG2癌细胞更有效，这也与MTT实验结果一致。
